sources.snippet: What is Adaptive Chunking? No single chunking method works best for every document in a RAG pipeline. Adaptive Chunking solves this by evaluating multiple chunking strategies against a set of intrinsic quality metrics and automatically selecting the best one for each document.

sources.title: Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling
sources.snippet: Dynamic Chunking: End-to-end Sequence Modeling Without Tokenization In this work, we introduce an end-to-end hierarchical network (H-Net) that compresses raw data through a recursive, data-dependent dynamic chunking (DC) process (Figure 1).
